line: Acer Predator Helios Neo 18 AI (2025, PHN18-72)
config_name: Predator Helios Neo 18 AI — Ultra 9 275HX / RTX 5070 Ti 12GB, 32GB DDR5, 2TB SSD, 18" WQXGA IPS 240Hz (+ bundled 1TB drive/dock set)

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop 12GB GDDR7 (Advanced Optimus)

price.notes: BBY CA verified 2026-11-24: reg $6,729, sale $4,699. Marketplace DOCK-BUNDLE SET (laptop + 1TB drive/dock) — bundle inflates listed reg price. Marketplace fulfillment/return risk.

offers.name: Acer Predator Neo 18 AI 18" 240Hz Gaming Laptop,Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX,GeForce RTX 5070 Ti,32GB RAM,2TB SSD+1TB Dock Set,4-Zone Backlit Keyboard,Win 11,Black

reviews.quote: Aggregated scoring places it at around 76% overall, indicating a solid but not flawless package.

reviews.outlet: Tom's Guide (sibling Neo 16 AI, same 5070 Ti/275HX)
reviews.quote: An ineffective cooling system, slow SSD hampered by bloatware, bulky design, and short battery life make the Neo 16 AI a hard sell.

professional.note: No dedicated pro review of the PHN18-72 Neo 18 AI; anchored from NBC-reviewed PHN16-73 (same CPU/GPU). Honest null for this exact config.

praises: 2TB internal + 1TB bundled drive = a game-library-sized storage stack without opening the case
32GB DDR5 + 12GB RTX 5070 Ti + 24-core 275HX — no day-one upgrade needed
18" 240Hz matte canvas with full-TGP graphics and cooling headroom
Extra M.2 slot means storage grows without replacing the boot drive
USB4/TB4 + Wi-Fi 7 + RJ-45 — no dongle life
complaints: Bundle reg pricing is inflated; storage premium here exceeds DIY M.2 pricing by a lot
3.5 kg + big brick — desktop replacement only
Matte IPS panel is mid for media vs OLED siblings
Short battery; 18" HX machines live plugged in

design_philosophy: The 2TB tier of the Neo 18 AI sweet spot: same reviewed-class internals as the 1TB/32GB config with double storage for large game libraries and media, sold through retailer bundle sets. It fits Acer's value-flagship philosophy — pay for silicon and storage, not for the display or chassis.
rating_notes: Inferred from NBC 76% PHN16-73 anchor + 18" deltas per SHARED-predator.md (same as 32GB/1TB twin 125.json, +0.1 creative_work for 2TB working storage). Dock-bundle caveat in price.notes. No dedicated pro review — honest null.
